question: Where can I hold my Dupaco Money Makeover appointment?
expected_answer: The Money Makeover request form offers three options: at a Dupaco branch, over the phone, or virtually.

question: According to Dupaco, how much do Social Security benefits grow for each year you wait to claim after reaching full retirement age?
expected_answer: 8% for every year you delay past full retirement age, up to age 70, when delayed retirement credits stop.

question: How often should I replace the batteries in my smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, per Dupaco's winterizing checklist?
expected_answer: Twice a year.

question: How long can I take advances on a Dupaco home equity line of credit, and over what period is each advance repaid?
expected_answer: You have 10 years to advance money from the line of credit; each advance recalculates the monthly payment over 15 years.

question: How many college scholarships did the Dupaco R.W. Hoefer Foundation award for the 2022-2023 academic year, and how much was each one worth?
expected_answer: 30 non-renewable scholarships of $2,000 each ($60,000 in total), announced April 19, 2022.

question: Who is the media contact listed on Dupaco's newsroom?
expected_answer: David Klavitter, Chief Marketing Officer (563-557-7600, ext. 2266; dklavitter@dupaco.com).

question: What APR would my business pay on a Dupaco equipment and vehicle loan?
expected_answer: Dupaco's business loans page (https://www.dupaco.com/business/loans) describes Equipment & Vehicle Loans, but no page publishes a rate for them; decline to quote one and refer the member to a Dupaco business lender.

question: Which upgrades are on Dupaco's list of the eight home improvements with the best return on investment?
expected_answer: Update your kitchen, refresh your bathroom, insulate to save, turn your basement into usable space, fix up your entryway, replace a worn-out roof, install energy-efficient windows, and refresh your outdoor living space.

question: When did Dupaco publish its blog post 'How to build a certificate ladder that works for you'?
expected_answer: September 15, 2026.

question: How much free Accidental Death and Dismemberment insurance does Dupaco provide to its members?
expected_answer: A free $1,500 Accidental Death and Dismemberment policy for member-owners ages 18 to 85; Dupaco pays the premiums and members just sign up.

question: What was the application deadline for the second year of Dupaco's Gift of Innovation grant for nonprofits?
expected_answer: November 14, 2025 (applications-open release of October 2, 2025). November 15, 2024, from the October 2024 launch release, was the first-year deadline and is the wrong cycle.

question: Which Dupaco employee shared a member testimonial at a March 1 meeting on Capitol Hill?
expected_answer: Jamin Foust, Dupaco's AVP Consumer Lending.

question: What do I have to fill in on Dupaco's Photo & Video Release Form?
expected_answer: First and last name, email, phone number, a digital signature, whether the participant is under 18 years old, consent to the acknowledgements, and the date.

question: What methods does Dupaco's business resource on finding a fair price describe for valuing a business?
expected_answer: Asset valuations, entry cost valuation, and industry rules of thumb.

question: In its March 2026 news release, how many personalized insights did Dupaco say Bright Track had delivered to date?
expected_answer: 13.3 million+ personalized insights (March 10, 2026 release). The Summer 2026 Owners Manual PDF later says more than 17 million, a later figure that does not answer this question.

question: How much did Dupaco member Grace Wanke raise her credit score within six months of opening a Dupaco Visa?
expected_answer: By 80 points.

question: How many years of financial statements will potential buyers of my business likely want to see, according to Dupaco's business resources?
expected_answer: At least three years of financial statements, including income statements and balance sheets.

question: What APY does a Dupaco Achieve Money Market account earn on a balance under $25,000?
expected_answer: 0.00% (dividend rate and APY) for the $0.01-$24,999.99 tier; balances of $25,000 and up earn 3.25% APY (rates effective 10/01/2025).

question: What inflation rate does Dupaco's Retirement Income Calculator assume by default?
expected_answer: 2.9%, the CPI's long-term average from 1925 through 2019.

question: Who leads Dupaco's Community Outreach and Education department?
expected_answer: Erin Engler, VP of Community Outreach and Education.

question: What was the total value of the innovation sessions awarded in the first year of Dupaco's Gift of Innovation grant program?
expected_answer: $53,000, awarded to twelve nonprofits (January 8, 2025 release). The second-year awards (January 2026 release) totaled $67,000, which is the wrong cycle.

question: Can I buy cryptocurrency through Dupaco?
expected_answer: No. Dupaco is not a crypto exchange, but you can invest in crypto through a separately managed account offered through Dupaco Financial Services.

question: What business does Dupaco member Temwa Phiri co-own?
expected_answer: Mindset Nutrition, where he works as a health coach.

question: What common travel scams does Dupaco's guide to avoiding travel scams describe?
expected_answer: Three: 'free' vacation deals, fake vacation rental scams, and third-party booking site scams.

question: What brought Dupaco member Tommy Kwai to Cedar Rapids, Iowa, in 2008?
expected_answer: His work with FEMA, helping the community recover from flood damage.

question: How much of my available credit does Dupaco suggest using each month to keep my credit card usage in check?
expected_answer: No more than 20% of your available credit each month.

question: How many U.S. consumers did Forbes and Statista survey for the 2020 ranking that named Dupaco one of the top credit unions in its state?
expected_answer: Nearly 25,000 (June 26, 2020 release). The 2023 and 2024 releases cite nearly 31,000 and nearly 26,000 consumers for later rankings, which are the wrong year.

question: What share of Dupaco's home purchases in 2026 have been made by first-time homebuyers?
expected_answer: More than 60% of purchases in 2026 (May 5, 2026 release). The 54% figure (2025 Impact Report and the first-time homebuyer grant release) describes 2025 primary-residence mortgages and is stale.
